source_question: Kenneth R. Davidson, Adam Dor-On, Orr M. Shalit, and Baruch Solel, *Dilations, inclusions of matrix convex sets, and completely positive maps*, arXiv:1601.07993. Local PDF: source_paper.pdf. Source location: page 35, Remark 7.21. The authors ask whether the universal factor d can be improved for a particular d-dimensional convex body and, specifically, whether d is optimal for the cube [-1,1]^d.
